title: UAAP: Tamaraws overwhelm Blue Eagles for fourth straight win
summary: Far Eastern University zoomed to its fourth straight win after overwhelming Ateneo de Manila University in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
